semiconductor_relevance: High — Pomme Technologies specializes in high-end wafer test integration and design services for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Pomme Technologies Co., Ltd provides advanced wafer parameter test solutions tailored for various sectors within the semiconductor industry, including IC design houses and testing companies. Established in 2015 in Hsinchu, Taiwan, the company focuses on streamlining testing processes to enhance product throughput and efficiency.
